### David Hume on reason

David Hume (1711–1776) approaches reason within Empiricism. All ideas derive from impressions; meaningful philosophy traces terms to experience. Causation is constant conjunction plus customary projection, not perceived necessary connection. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets reason most directly—useful for searches such as “david hume quotes on reason.”

### How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the [David Hume thinker page](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/david-hume) for biography and to the [reason theme](https://www.philosophydef.com/themes/reason) for other voices on the same question.
